title: Palette (palette.json)
description: The pack's named colours. Every colour a pack uses (on the map, for grades, in pictures) is a name from here; the colour numbers live only in this file. The default colours (grey, white, green, cyan, blue, violet, yellow, orange, red) are always there: list one to change it. The UI pack's styles use the default names, so changing one here changes the interface's colour too, in this game only.

$schema.description: Path to this file's schema, for editors. Ignored by the engine.

palette.description: One colour of the palette: its name, used everywhere a colour goes, and its 256-colour terminal number. The default colours are always there (grey 245, white 255, green 114, cyan 80, blue 75, violet 141, yellow 221, orange 208, red 203); list one to change it.

id.description: The colour's name, e.g. rust or hull. Plain words, no prefix.

code.description: The 256-colour terminal number: 0-15 the terminal's own colours, 16-231 a 6x6x6 colour cube, 232-255 greys from dark to light.
